- **`legacy_deleted_in`: `4e1973b40d92`** ("Clean up old code") deleted `src/legacy.js`.
- **`most_changed_file`: `src/routes.js`**, changed in 20 of the 40 commits. The next highest is `src/server.js` with 9.
- **`lines_added_by_carol`: 73**, added across her 19 commits. The repository has only one branch and no merge or binary-file commits, so nothing distorts that count.
